OVATION.definition: Enthusiastic recognition (especially one accompanied by loud applause).

ANTI.definition: Not in favor of (an action or proposal etc.).

NOVA.gloss: a star that ejects some of its material in the form of a cloud and becomes more…
NOVA.definition: A star that ejects some of its material in the form of a cloud and becomes more luminous in the process.

VAIN.definition: Characteristic of false pride; having an exaggerated sense of self-importance.

TOON.gloss: a film made by photographing a series of cartoon drawings to give the illusion of…
TOON.definition: A film made by photographing a series of cartoon drawings to give the illusion of movement when projected in rapid sequence.

IOTA.gloss: a tiny or scarcely detectable amount
IOTA.definition: A tiny or scarcely detectable amount.

NOT.gloss: negation of a word or group of words
NOT.definition: Negation of a word or group of words.

TOO.gloss: to a degree exceeding normal or proper limits
TOO.definition: To a degree exceeding normal or proper limits.

VAN.gloss: any creative group active in the innovation and application of new concepts and…
VAN.definition: Any creative group active in the innovation and application of new concepts and techniques in a given field (especially in the arts).

TON.gloss: a United States unit of weight equivalent to 2000 pounds
TON.definition: A United States unit of weight equivalent to 2000 pounds.

ION.gloss: a particle that is electrically charged
ION.definition: A particle that is electrically charged (positive or negative); an atom or molecule or group that has lost or gained one or more electrons.

TIN.gloss: a silvery malleable metallic element that resists corrosion
TIN.definition: A silvery malleable metallic element that resists corrosion; used in many alloys and to coat other metals to prevent corrosion; obtained chiefly from cassiterite where it occurs as tin oxide.

TAN.gloss: a browning of the skin resulting from exposure to the rays of the sun
TAN.definition: A browning of the skin resulting from exposure to the rays of the sun.

ANT.gloss: social insect living in organized colonies
ANT.definition: Social insect living in organized colonies; characteristically the males and fertile queen have wings during breeding season; wingless sterile females are the workers.
